provenance.recruitmentDefinition: Candidate-player train actions across all 1,800 final games per model. Excludes spawned units, conversions and boat upgrades. Early recruits use recorded engine turn <=20.
provenance.actionLogValidation: Original full private SHA256 checked, or accepted compact blob SHA256 checked; 360 audited receipts and source/Wasm hashes checked per submission.
provenance.unitMixIsDescriptive: Recruit shares are action-weighted over the fixed panel, not a causal explanation of score.
